default.description: User-controlled primary session model. RoleBench never automatically rotates or replaces it.

plan.description: Configured plan-mode primary with the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain; never weighted.

advisor.description: Configured advisor/watchdog primary plus the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain; never weighted.

reviewer.description: Configured native /review primary plus the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain; never weighted.

smol.description: Fast bounded helper work invoked on behalf of the primary model.

slow.description: Configured thinking-role primary plus the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain; never weighted.

vision.description: Configured vision primary plus the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain for image-grounded operations; never weighted.

designer.description: Configured designer primary plus the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain for designer-agent execution; never weighted.

tiny.description: Titles, metadata, classification, memory, and other tightly bounded utility operations.

task.description: Autonomous delegated child-agent execution, optionally specialized by a task pool lane.
